title: TACT-KV: Tri-Axis Cosine Transform for Compressing Volumetric KV Caches in Medical VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.07593v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) applied to 3D medical scans face a structural memory wall. A single CT or MRI volume produces tens of thousands of vision tokens, and the resulting key-value (KV) cache scales linearly with both batch and context. Existing KV compression methods operate on the cache's feature or token statistics, or apply 1D and 2D transforms, leaving the three-axis spatial structure in the cache unexploited. We propose TACT-KV (Tri-Axis Cosine Transform), a calibration-free KV compression method that exploits strong spatial correlations in visual KV states along all three anatomical axes of 3D scans. This correlation concentrates the KV cache energy under a frequency-domain transform. TACT-KV applies a separable 3D discrete cosine transform to the KV cache, allocates a per-layer bit budget across frequency bins via reverse water-filling (more bits to high-energy components), and quantizes each bin with a fixed scalar code

translated_title: TACT-KV：用于压缩医学视觉语言模型中体积KV缓存的三轴余弦变换
translated_abstract: 应用于3D医学扫描的视觉语言模型（VLM）面临结构性的内存墙问题。单个CT或MRI体积会产生数万个视觉token，由此产生的键值（KV）缓存随批大小和上下文长度线性增长。现有的KV压缩方法仅在缓存的特征或token统计上操作，或应用一维和二维变换，未能利用缓存中的三轴空间结构。我们提出TACT-KV（三轴余弦变换），这是一种无需校准的KV压缩方法，它利用3D扫描中视觉KV状态沿所有三个解剖轴的强空间相关性。这种相关性使KV缓存的能量在频域变换下得以集中。TACT-KV对KV缓存应用可分离的3D离散余弦变换，通过逆注水算法在频率区间上分配每层比特预算（为高能量分量分配更多比特），并使用固定的标量码本对每个区间进行量化。
tldr: 提出TACT-KV，一种无需校准的KV压缩方法，通过对KV缓存施加可分离的3D离散余弦变换并结合逆注水比特分配，利用3D医学扫描的三轴空间相关性来压缩医学视觉语言模型中的体积KV缓存。
en_tdlr: TACT-KV is a calibration-free KV cache compression method that applies a separable 3D discrete cosine transform with reverse water-filling bit allocation to exploit tri-axis spatial correlations in volumetric medical scans, effectively compressing KV caches in medical VLMs.
